description: Data table on the density tokens. Table draws the header row from `columns`, owns the grid and its keyboard, and injects into each row where it sits; the consumer writes one TableRow per row and one TableCell per cell, so a cell's content is a value or one of Arena's own components rather than something returned from a per-item render function. Below --bp-md it becomes one card per row, measured on its own container rather than the viewport.

label.description: Names the grid for assistive technology. Required, and guarded at runtime: nothing can derive it — Calendar names its grid from the range it is showing, and a data table's subject is editorial. Say what the rows are, never "Table".

columns.description: The columns, in order. A column heads and sets its cells; it never says what goes in them.

content.description: The rows. One TableRow per row; Table injects where each row sits, the columns its cells are set against, and how the keyboard reaches them.

empty.description: What shows when no row is written.

responsive.description: Card mode below --bp-md. Set false only when the columns are meaningless apart.
